title: Taxonomies: Filter the Content Items List by Term | Orchard Core
description:
As a site grows, so does the Content Items list, and the items that share a category or a tag are spread through it.

The Taxonomies Contents List Filters feature adds a filter to the Content Items list for each taxonomy you choose, so the list can show only the content items that have one term.

In this video:
• Why you filter the Content Items list by term
• Enabling the Taxonomies Contents List Filters feature
• Choosing the taxonomies to filter by in Settings, Taxonomy Filters
• Filtering the list by a term, with Show all and Clear filter
• How the taxonomy filters follow the content type
